Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the right lane of a Baytown, Texas roawday when Driver 1 signaled and began moving left to
change lanes. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the adjacent left lane, moved into the same space at roughly the same
time, and the two vehicles sideswiped one another. Driver 1 stated that the contact was sudden and that Driver 1 was
unable to avoid it. Driver 2 gave a statement consistent with that account, and two independent witnesses at the
scene described the lane change and the contact in the same way. Photographs taken at the scene show damage
along the left side of Driver 1's vehicle and matching scraping on the right side of Driver 2's vehicle, which is
consistent with the reported impact. Drvier 1 is the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Passenger was
seated in the front passenger position and reported pain in the right knee after the collision. Responding officers
confirmed Passenger's presence in the vehicle at the time of the crash. No prior damage to the vehicle was reported
or observed during the inspection. Passenger was tranpsorted for evaluation, and the reported knee injury is a
plausible result of the forces involved in this type of collision.
